'''''Whell''''' was a [[Cargo ferry]] used by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s [[Admiral Harkov's fleet|fleet]] when they defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].

''Whell'' was present at the first stage of the [[Battle of Ottega]], trying to bring supplies to the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory-class)|Protector]]. It was destroyed not long into the skirmish.
